gaps.gap: Need platform/action trace and comparable denominator; apparent reach gaps can be caused by policy, ranking, behavior, confounding or measurement error.
Meta materially changed its political recommendation/ranking approach between 2021-2025.
Specific public orders/requests exist, but aggregate DSA data show platform own terms dominate; state tasking must be proven action by action.
Substantial appeal reversal rates show material error/correction; complaint != proof and initial action != final truth.
Exposure shifts are real and sometimes asymmetric, but downstream persuasion/vote/outcome is not identified by these visibility studies.
No current France/UE design closes a specific visibility restriction -> person-level exposure delta -> persuasion/vote -> changed electoral result chain.
